messages:
Maya Li: Hi team — pushed a small follow-up to PR #4523 that addresses the underflow edge-case in max_batch_size. I also applied Owen's metrics-tag suggestion. PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4523
Owen Park: Thanks — will review later today after standup
Maya Li: Added a unit test and a short changelog entry. Behavior is backward-compatible but bumped default max_batch_size from 16 -> 32.
Kai Nguyen: quick question: why bump the default? perf numbers?
Maya Li: Yep — microbenchmarks showed ~12% better throughput on common seq lengths with negligible p95 impact. Bench command I used:
```bash
./tools/bench_throughput --model rlinf-13b --seq 1024 --runs 30
```
Also attached the raw numbers in the PR comments.
Samir Khan: Left two tiny nits inline (var name + logging). PTAL @Maya, nothing functional.
Maya Li: Addressed both nits: renamed `mbs` -> `max_batch_size` and reduced the log verbosity to DEBUG. Added a comment linking to the perf notes.
Owen Park: LGTM pending CI. macOS runner flaked on a unrelated test yesterday; I retried it. @deploy-bot any status?
deploy-bot: CI_STATUS: queued -> running -> passed (all checks green on second try).
Owen Park: I'll merge once CI is green for 10 more minutes, unless anyone objects by EOD PST.
Kai Nguyen: :thumbsup: no objections from me.
Maya Li: Thanks! I'll monitor canary for tokenization/throughput regression post-merge and have a rollback patch ready if anything odd shows up.
Maya Li: PTAL final when you can, otherwise feel free to merge after CI — small change but want to be conservative on rollout.
